title: n8n support email workflow: Gmail, AI check, Pinecone answers, reply in thread

facts: Post: n8n AI Automation Specialist, Customer Support Email Workflow. Fixed price, client in Texas. Green lit by Lorenzo 2026-10-22 7:00 PM CT, rebuilt on legacy sales-deck template per Lorenzo 7:33 PM CT.

cover.beat: Hi, I'm Lorenzo. I read your post and put together the support email workflow you described. Let's follow one support email from your inbox to the reply in the same thread. Everything here is sample data.

scenes.title: One support email, start to finish.
scenes.caption: It checks if it's support, looks up the answer in Pinecone, and replies in the same thread.
scenes.beat: Say Tessa from a pilates studio emails your support inbox. The workflow keeps her sender, subject, body, message ID and thread ID. OpenAI checks if it's a support request, and anything else leaves with no reply. Her question goes to your Pinecone index as an OpenAI embedding. The best match clears the bar, so OpenAI writes the reply from those articles and it goes back in her thread. A weak match goes to a person instead.
details: 0:10 to 0:55. Point at each lit node in order, then at the two branches that stay grey.
Your build starts on the n8n Gmail Trigger. This sample run starts by hand with Tessa's email.
The {{kb.bar}} score bar is a sample setting we agree together. Keys stay in n8n credentials, never in the workflow JSON.

scenes.title: Every email ends up in the right place.

scenes.beat: Here's a sample day. Tessa got her answer. A vendor newsletter left with no reply. Jonah asked something your knowledge base doesn't cover, so his best match was low, no AI reply went out, and your support lead got it. And when Gmail failed on Rita's reply, it retried and then sent.
